run_agent_eval: run the Atari agent evaluation binary with absl flags for subprocess and logging control
run_eval_with_subprocess: run the agent evaluator launching the agent and robot binary as subprocesses
run_eval_with_log_saving: run the agent evaluation and save subprocess logs to a specified directory
run_eval_with_console_logs: run the agent evaluation and display subprocess stdout and stderr in the console
run_eval_with_custom_log_dir: run the agent evaluation and store subprocess logs in a custom directory path
